methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator concentrates deep capability building in Hampton Roads metro hub, creating regional excellence node but raising questions about spillover to surrounding rural areas without distributed training infrastructure.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA signals community-driven literacy efforts that could distribute foundational AI fluency through peer networks if scaled beyond university walls into broader Richmond workforce.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents grassroots capacity building in historically underserved region, testing whether distributed skill development can overcome concentrated metro advantage.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA's pilot AI literacy courses signal institutional capacity for deep learning in elite educational settings, but university-level access reinforces concentrated knowledge in credentialed populations rather than broad workforce distribution.

signals.title: Virginia's Dominion and NextEra make $67B merger deal as AI drives energy demand - NBC4 Washington
signals.signal_reading: Dominion-NextEra merger driven by AI energy demand positions Virginia as infrastructure provider for platform-delivered AI services, creating shallow, consumption-oriented relationship with AI rather than development capability.
